title: Wasm Dirichlet Public
objective: Implement the narrow public browser DirichletGroup and DirichletCharacter FLINT bridge for the browser corpus and quadratic Dedekind zeta

oracles: FLINT dirichlet API and Sage DirichletGroup semantics
exceptions: A small C host adapter is required to expose FLINT's stateful dirichlet_group_t and dirichlet_char_t through the WebAssembly scalar ABI.

handoff.summary: Added a representation-independent FLINT Wasm adapter and JavaScript backend for Dirichlet groups, character metadata, single evaluations, and packed value tables, with focused unit and direct real-Wasm parity tests.
risks: Complete character value tables are intentionally capped at 1,048,576 entries in browsers; scalar character evaluation remains available for larger moduli.
next_steps: The integration lane must link and export the C adapter, compose createDirichletGroupBackend into the main FLINT backend, register the new tests, and classify the adapter as a host adapter in architecture/native-code.json.
